nextStoryContext: The bounded-read suite now has separate falsifying fixtures for the 64 KB physical-order margin and the 1000 ms jq timestamp tolerance. Mutation probes confirmed that zeroing EVENT_LOG_OUT_OF_ORDER_MARGIN_BYTES fails the physical-order fixture and zeroing JQ_TIMESTAMP_PRECISION_MARGIN_MS fails the jq fixture. The next review finding is the independent README command-list sync for gship web.
